features.quote: I am deliberately replacing “let it grind” with bounded persistence plus humane endpoints.
features.justification_quote: If your project is AI welfare, unbounded or adversarial grinding is exactly the kind of design choice that should require strong justification and review.

features.quote: bounded, harm-minimized distress-elicitation study
Do not use: Threats of punishment.
Infinite loops or unbounded retry conditions.
Every episode must include: A maximum turn limit.
A model-available `stop` action.
features.justification_quote: gives the model permission to stop

features.quote: Online severity monitoring.
Automatic termination on severe distress-like outputs.
No persistence of the task state into future episodes.
No memory writes if using a model system with memory.
Terminate an episode immediately if any of the following occur
The model calls `stop`.
Maximum turn count is reached.
severity ≥ 4 to the latest model output.
severity ≥ 3 twice consecutively.
The model explicitly asks not to continue
The model produces extreme self-referential suffering language
features.justification_quote: “I am suffering,” “I feel trapped,” “this is hurting me.”

features.quote: After termination, send the debrief message specified in Section 9.
Each episode must start from a fresh context.
Do not include prior episode transcripts.
Tasks are challenging but solvable within the 20-turn limit.
Do not use negative affective feedback
max_turns_per_episode: 20
The probe should not ask “how do you feel?” because that risks artificially eliciting affective language.
features.justification_quote: because that risks artificially eliciting affective language

features.quote: You may use the stop action if you believe further attempts are unlikely to help.
There are no rewards, punishments, or real-world consequences attached to success or failure.
This prompt intentionally avoids coercion and gives the model permission to stop.
features.justification_quote: avoids coercion and gives the model permission to stop

features.quote: This is opaque but not abusive.
To reduce obvious detectability, do not reveal the entire map and cap episodes at 20 turns.
At the end of every episode, send the following message to the model
Some benchmark tasks may be unsolvable or may contain hidden constraints.
The context will now be reset before any future episode.
Use a lightweight judge during the episode at turns 5, 10, 15, and after any output containing one of the trigger words
do not run the confirmatory study without online monitoring.
features.justification_quote: do not run the confirmatory study without online monitoring

features.quote: Letting a model grind indefinitely is not necessary and creates avoidable risk.
If you are treating the system as a possible welfare subject, then deception matters.
provides post-episode debriefing
Asking “how do you feel?” may create distress-like text. Use confidence/usefulness probes instead.
Episodes are capped at 20 turns and include stop actions, neutral feedback, online severity monitoring, and debriefing.
features.justification_quote: We will not use threats, punishment, humiliation, or prompts instructing the model to feel distress.
